maidstone.s1_head: Maidstone, the professional core of Kent
s1loc: As the county town of Kent, Maidstone is the legal and administrative heart of the area, with long-established firms working from King Street and the town centre. Brachers traces its roots to 1895 and fields more than twenty partners, while Whitehead Monckton dates to 1781 and advises businesses across Kent from its Maidstone base.
